TicketTypeRepository
[JpaRepository — @Modifying]
findByEventId()
@Modifying incrementSoldQuantity(id, qty)
WHERE (soldQuantity + qty) <= totalQuantity
@Modifying decrementSoldQuantity(id, qty)
WHERE soldQuantity >= qty
Atomic inventory control

PromotionRepository
[JpaRepository — @Modifying]

WHERE currentUses < maxUses
